nodes.label: Variant C: Modern Split Refined
nodes.rationale: Synthesizes Variant A's split sliding layout but upgrades it with an ultra-smooth layout transition using GPU-accelerated width scaling, opacity fading, and viewport perspective. Features ChatGPT-like conversational bubble styles and pill input.

nodes.label: Opaque-Box Testing Strategy
nodes.rationale: Testing via HTTP APIs and browser automation ensures tests are resilient to internal code structure changes.

nodes.label: Lockout Simulation via IP Headers
nodes.rationale: Uses customized X-Forwarded-For headers to simulate distinct client IPs from a single test runner machine.

nodes.label: Database-Asserted Audit Log Checks
nodes.rationale: Verifies audit logging side-effects by checking database records directly rather than relying only on HTTP responses.

nodes.label: AI Direct Database Access Restriction
nodes.rationale: Inversely enforces security: AI agents must never access PostgreSQL directly. All agent data access goes through the agent-gateway, which strips PII and enforces scoped access.

nodes.label: NestJS Architecture Conventions
nodes.rationale: Modular architecture following module -> controller -> service -> repository flow. Controllers handle HTTP/validation, services handle business logic.

nodes.label: Next.js App Router Conventions
nodes.rationale: Server components by default. Next.js is frontend-only; all business logic and API requests are forwarded to NestJS.

nodes.label: Audit Logging Conventions
nodes.rationale: All transactional state changes must be recorded in the audit_logs table, including timestamp, user_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, and PII-free metadata.

nodes.label: E2E Test Triggers
nodes.rationale: Mandates E2E testing when changes touch database schemas, the booking/payment critical path, or cross multiple NestJS modules.

nodes.label: Read-Only Agent Action Scope
nodes.rationale: Strictly read-only agent actions prevent non-deterministic LLMs from executing transactional operations or mutating database state.

nodes.label: NestJS Agent Gateway PII Boundary
nodes.rationale: Dedicated API gateway that sanitizes, scopes, and audits all agent data requests. Creates a structural boundary preventing PII leakage to LLM context.

nodes.label: Signed User Claim Token
nodes.rationale: Uses HMAC-SHA256 signed tokens to authenticate service-to-service calls. Prevents userId forgery and handles token expiration gracefully.

nodes.label: LangGraph State Machine Orchestration
nodes.rationale: Implements LangGraph with MemorySaver checkpointing to allow human-in-the-loop gates for write confirmations.

nodes.label: Direct SSE Chat Streaming Flow
nodes.rationale: Connects Next.js directly to the FastAPI agent for chat streaming. Avoids double-connection latency of proxying via NestJS.

nodes.label: NeMo Input Guardrails Layer
nodes.rationale: Filters user input prior to processing by LLM to block prompt injection and jailbreaks.

nodes.label: Sliding Window + Summary Memory
nodes.rationale: Saves tokens and manages context window. Keeps last N messages raw, summarizes previous conversation history out-of-band.

nodes.label: Sentence-Boundary Chunking
nodes.rationale: Chunks streaming output at punctuation boundaries to give the safety guardrails complete semantic context for scanning.

nodes.label: Pipeline Parallel Guardrail Check
nodes.rationale: Hides guardrail latency by validating the next sentence chunk concurrently while streaming the current chunk to the user.

nodes.label: Cross-Chunk Sliding Window Check
nodes.rationale: Scans token overlap between consecutive chunks to detect PII patterns that span sentence boundaries.

nodes.label: Layered Safety Checks (Regex + NeMo)
nodes.rationale: Optimizes speed and depth: first runs a fast regex PII scanner, then runs the NeMo output safety rail check.

nodes.label: Safety Hard Stop Mode
nodes.rationale: Kills the streaming connection immediately and sends a failure SSE event upon any safety violation, rather than attempting redaction.

nodes.label: Deterministic Transaction Boundary Rule
nodes.rationale: LLMs are non-deterministic and unsuitable for transactions. Booking and payment flows must be auditable, deterministic backend services.

nodes.label: Database Initialization & Auth Handshake Spec Quality Checklist
nodes.norm_label: database initialization & auth handshake spec quality checklist

nodes.label: Monorepo Bootstrap Decision
nodes.rationale: Bootstrap a minimal monorepo layout (apps/api, apps/web, packages/shared) to satisfy shared-type and handshake requirements since no application source code exists yet.

nodes.label: NestJS Auth Backend Decision
nodes.rationale: Use NestJS for auth endpoints and guards to enforce validation, modular boundaries, and injectability.

nodes.label: Prisma Migrations Decision
nodes.rationale: Use version-controlled Prisma database migrations for user and audit tables to support repeatable schema initialization.

nodes.label: Stateless JWT Sessions Decision
nodes.rationale: Use stateless 24-hour JWT sessions to satisfy the requirement of no server-side session storage for v1.

nodes.label: Redis Auth Abuse State Decision
nodes.rationale: Store rate limits and lockout count state in Redis to avoid coupling abuse state with stateless tokens or polluting PostgreSQL.

nodes.label: PII-free Audit Logs Decision
nodes.rationale: Log auth actions using user ID references and hashes instead of emails or passwords to satisfy privacy constraints.

nodes.label: FastAPI Framework Decision
nodes.rationale: Use FastAPI for Python agent endpoints due to its async-first loop, direct SSE support, and Pydantic DTO parsing.

nodes.label: SSE Streaming Decision
nodes.rationale: Use sse-starlette's EventSourceResponse to deliver real-time token-by-token streaming mapped to LangChain async generation.

nodes.label: FastAPI JWT Validation Decision
nodes.rationale: FastAPI middleware validates HS256 JWT tokens using the same JWT_SECRET secret from NestJS auth.

nodes.label: Input Guardrails Decision
nodes.rationale: Implement GuardrailService protocol using NeMo Guardrails to scan input messages. Fails closed.

nodes.label: Chat Persistence Routing Decision
nodes.rationale: Route agent chat history persistence through NestJS REST API endpoints by forwarding user JWT context.

nodes.label: Conversation Memory Strategy Decision
nodes.rationale: Apply a manual sliding window of recent messages + async post-response summarization message generation when budget is exceeded.

nodes.label: Message Concurrency Queue Decision
nodes.rationale: Queue and serialize concurrent user inputs via per-conversation asyncio.Queue, rejecting when max depth is hit.
